title: Illustration Level 1
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Synthesize elements and principles of design with illustration skills and techniques in varying pictorial formats that range from simple to complex in achromatic value and color.
Develop skills in the use of tools and materials, which are common to the field
Recognize, analyze and interpret the expressive and creative qualities of art media in a work of art as it affects compositional decisions.
Use value to describe form and express light logic.
Utilize quick study drawing skills through visual notes and personal studies as a basis for planning larger extended works of art.
Create original illustrations that interpret the visual world.

notes: The catalog prints 'ARTD 20'; the closed list stores it as 'ARTD20' (no space, units not stored). Treated as the same course, not a catalog addition.
ANIM 104 and ARTD 15A are printed as 'or' options to ARTC 90 with no units beside them; units left null.
The 'Total Units 18' under the course list matches the certificate total of 18 units stated in the overview; recorded as the program total rather than a separate block total.

The outcomes were printed in the Overview tab under 'Students who successfully complete the program will be able to:'. The Outcomes tab ('Program Learning Outcomes') prints only a link to review SLOs and no outcomes of its own.
Courses must be completed with a grade of C or higher.
